title: SourceMap
$comment: DRAFT — NEEDS_REVIEW. Field set is a hypothesis; no code reads it yet. See docs/DECISIONS.md D-0007 and specs/source-map.md (not authored yet).
description: Layer B artifact. Records where lesson content came from, so every downstream claim can be traced back to a source location. A SourceMap is evidence navigation, not knowledge.

version.description: Schema version this instance conforms to.

sourceId.description: Stable identifier of the source bundle this map describes.

sources.description: Evidence items referenced by the map (Layer A).

kind.description: Evidence category. Extend only with review.

location.description: Where the evidence lives (URI or repo-relative path). Must not point at a production Vault.

byteOrTimeRange.description: Optional locator inside the evidence, e.g. a timestamp range or page range. Free-form until specified.

quality.description: Optional observed quality of the evidence, e.g. caused by ASR noise.

entries.description: Mapping from a lesson-side unit to one or more evidence locations.

targetId.description: Identifier of the lesson-side unit (e.g. a LessonModel segment id).

locator.description: Locator inside that source. Free-form until specified.

confidence.description: How certain the mapping is. Never treat a machine confidence as a verified fact.
